strings.Downloads, videos and torrents use only: Li-downloads, livideo le li-torrents li sebelisa adapter ena feela (mohlala, VPN ea hau). Haeba e tlosoa, li-downloads li khutlela morao ho feta ho sebelisa kopano e ngoe.
strings.Torrent blocklist: a file or an https://: Torrent blocklist: a file or an https:// address (empty = none)
strings.Torrents never connect to the addresses: Li-torrents ha lia ka tsa hokahana le li-addresse tsena. Li-P2P, DAT le CIDR li sebetsa, hape e le.gz. Lebitso le tla khutlisoa letsatsi le leng le le leng.
strings.The blocklist address must start with ht: Leqephe la blocklist le tlameha ho qala ka https://
Faele ea blocklist ha e fumanehe.
strings.New items of these feeds are downloaded: Lintlha tse ncha tsa li-feeds tsena li bolokiloe ha sehlooho sa tsona se lumellana le molao: lifaele le livideo, le li-torrents ha li-torrents li sebetsa. Molao o bonts'a mantsoe ao ka bobeli a lokelang ho ba sehloohong, kapa /regular expression/.
strings.Feed address (RSS or Atom): Leqephe la ho fetisa (RSS kapa Atom)
strings.Download items whose title has all of th: Kopitsa lintho tseo sehlooho sa tsona se nang le mantsoe ana kaofela (ho se na = ntho e ngoe le e ngoe)
strings.Skip items whose title has any of these: E-na le lintho tse nang le lentsoe le leng kapa le leng la mantsoe ana
strings.Only download items that appear after th: Kopitsa feela lintho tse hlahang ka mor'a hore feed e kenyeletsoe
strings.The feed address must start with http://: Lebitso la feed le lokela ho qala ka http:// kapa https://
strings.The rule's regular expression is not val: Moelelo o tloaelehileng oa molao ha o nepahale.
strings.While I use the computer, limit download: Ha ke sebelisa khomphutha, ke tlose ho jarolla ho fihlela ho KB/s (0 = ho se na)
strings.Full speed again after a minute without: Bophara bo feletseng hape ka mor'a metsotso e seng mekae ntle le ho kenya keyboard kapa mouse.
strings.Your API key for the service: Setsi sa hau sa API bakeng sa ts'ebeletso
strings.Sites whose links go through it (comma s: Li-site tseo li-link tsa tsona li eang ho eona (li arotsoe ke li-comma, e.e. example-host.com)
strings.Off by default. Uses your own account; l: Ha e sebetse ka ho laoloa. E sebelisa ak'haonte ea hau ea hau; li-link ho tloha libakeng tse ling ha li romelloe ho ts'ebeletso. Setsi se bolokiloe ka mokhoa o bolokiloeng ka kotloloho'me se ke ke sa bolokiloe ho li-backup.
strings.Automatic configuration script (PAC): Skripte ea ho hlophisa ka ho toba (PAC)

strings.Enter the proxy script's web address (ht: Ikopanye le http: // kapa https://) kapa tsela e feletseng ea faele.

strings.Paste text with links, or a web page add: Ntlafatsa mongolo o nang le li-link, kapa aterese ea leqephe la marang-rang ebe o tobetsa Fumana Li-Links. Likarolo tsa archive e kopantsoeng li hlophisitsoe ka pakete e le 'ngoe.
strings.Save the whole gallery with the gallery: G_odisa galery ka ho feletseng ka engine ea galery (marang-rang a kang a Reddit, Pixiv, DeviantArt, Imgur; engine e bolokiloe ka nako ea pele)

strings.Wake the computer from sleep to start: Ntšeha khomphutha ho tloha ho robala ho ea ho qala
strings.Uses a Windows wake timer; Power Options: E sebelisa timer ea ho khutlisa ea Windows; Likhetho tsa matla li tlameha ho lumella timers tsa ho khutlisa. Program e tlameha ho sebetsa (e ka ba ka lebokoseng).

strings.Converting needs FFmpeg. MP3 uses the be: Ho fetola ho hloka FFmpeg. MP3 e sebelisa boleng bo sa fetoheng ka ho fetisisa; FLAC e boloka lintlha tsohle tsa molumo oo sebaka sena se o romellang.
strings.Downloads I resume myself: run this many: Li-downloads ke khutlisa ke le mong: kenya tse ngata ka nako e le 'ngoe ka lehlakoreng la li-queue (0 = li tlala slot ea li-queue)
strings.When the app starts, remove finished dow: Ha k'homphieutha e qala, tlosa li-downloads tse felileng tseo faele ea tsona e ileng ea tlosoa kapa ea fetisoa

strings.Settings, the download list and unfinish: Litlhophiso, lethathamo la ho jarolla le likarolo tse sa felleng li bolokiloe
strings.The data moves the next time the app sta: Data e fetisetsoa ha e qala ka mor'a moo. Likopi tsohle li kopitsoe'me li hlahlojoa pele ho tlosoa kopi e fetileng.
Khetha tsela e feletseng ea lebokoseng la liphutheloana.
Data e teng kantle ho lebokoseng lena.
strings.Choose a folder that is not inside the c: Khetha sehokela se seng se seng ka hare ho sehokela sa data sa hona joale (kapa ka tsela e fapaneng).
strings.Put a range in square brackets: [001-100: Sebelisa lipakeng tsa li-brackets tse sephara: [001-100] e boloka li-digits tse tharo, [1-100] ha e etse joalo, [a-z] e sebelisa li-letters le [0-100:5] e bala ka li-five. Li-list tse ka har'a li-brackets, {jpg,png}, li leka ka 'ngoe. Lipakeng tse ngata li fetoloa.
strings.Words find links that contain them; * an: Mantsoe a fumana li-link tse nang le tsona; * le? ke li-wildcards;! e ka pele e tlosa li-link. Mohlala: *.jpg!*thumb*
